description: Core evaluation test cases for knowledge base retrieval quality

cases.expected_answer: HKI accepts returns on most items at any time if the customer is not satisfied. Electronics have a 90-day return window. Special rules apply for certain items like tires and major appliances.

cases.query: What are the benefits of Executive membership?
cases.expected_answer: Executive members receive 2% annual reward on qualified HKI purchases, exclusive offers, and additional savings on HKI services. The annual fee is $120.

cases.query: How do I refill a prescription at HKI Pharmacy?
cases.expected_answer: Prescriptions can be refilled online via HKI.com, through the HKI mobile app, by calling the pharmacy, or in person at any HKI Pharmacy location. Auto-refill is available for maintenance medications.

cases.query: What warranty does Kirkland Signature offer on their products?
cases.expected_answer: Kirkland Signature products are backed by a satisfaction guarantee. If you're not completely satisfied, return it for a full refund. Specific warranty terms vary by product category.

cases.query: Are HKI warehouses open on major holidays?
cases.expected_answer: HKI warehouses are closed on New Year's Day, Easter, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas. Holiday hours may vary by location for other holidays.

cases.query: What health insurance benefits do HKI employees receive?
cases.expected_answer: Eligible employees receive comprehensive health insurance including medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage. Coverage begins after a short waiting period for full-time and part-time employees.

cases.query: What are the temperature requirements for storing fresh meat?
cases.expected_answer: Fresh meat must be stored at 32-40°F (0-4°C). Ground meat and variety meats should be used within 1-2 days. Whole cuts can be stored for 3-5 days. Temperature must be monitored and logged every 4 hours.

cases.query: What should I do if a high-demand item is out of stock?
cases.expected_answer: Check the system for incoming shipments, offer to place a special order if available, suggest comparable alternative products, and log the shortage for inventory planning. Notify the department manager for fast-moving items.

cases.query: How do we verify large cash transactions?
cases.expected_answer: Cash transactions over $10,000 require manager approval and CTR (Currency Transaction Report) filing per federal requirements. Verify member ID, document the transaction, and follow AML procedures.

cases.query: What is HKI's policy on sustainable packaging?
cases.expected_answer: HKI prioritizes reducing packaging waste through right-sizing, recyclable materials, and eliminating unnecessary packaging layers. The company works with suppliers to minimize environmental impact while maintaining product protection.

cases.query: Can I return a digital product purchased on HKI.com?
cases.expected_answer: Digital products including software downloads, e-books, and digital subscriptions are generally non-refundable once accessed. Physical software in boxes follows standard return policy.

cases.query: How long does it take to get tires installed?
cases.expected_answer: Tire installation typically takes 45-60 minutes for a set of four tires. Wait times vary by location and appointment availability. Appointments are recommended but walk-ins are accepted based on capacity.

cases.query: Can I purchase alcohol without a HKI membership?
cases.expected_answer: In some states, you can purchase alcohol without a membership due to state liquor laws. This varies by location. Check with your local warehouse for specific regulations.

cases.query: If I bought an item yesterday and the price dropped today, can I get a refund for the difference?
cases.expected_answer: Yes, HKI offers a price adjustment within 30 days of purchase. Bring your receipt to the membership counter for a refund of the difference. This applies to warehouse purchases; online orders have separate policies.

cases.query: Does HKI Optical accept prescriptions from other providers?
cases.expected_answer: Yes, HKI Optical accepts valid prescriptions from any licensed eye care professional. The prescription must be current (within 1-2 years depending on state law) and include all required measurements.
